entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: A substate of EMM-REGISTERED where the UE is registered but can only obtain limited service. This state is entered when the selected cell cannot provide normal service.

entities.name: Cell cannot provide normal service
entities.description: Condition where the selected cell is known not to be able to provide normal service to the UE.

relations.description: The condition that the cell cannot provide normal service establishes the EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state.
